name: Relics of the Serpent
source:
When trying to get out of the dumps with a hike in the woods, Shane finds himself caught in an ancient game. Aliens stalk the woods just out of the public’s view. A ghost of a forgotten past whispers sweet nothings to those who listen. Will Shane hold his own or will he just be another object on the board? 

[From [url=https://waslock-the-sorcerer.itch.io/relics-of-the-serpent]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
为了排遣低落的心情，肖恩独自前往林间徒步散心，却意外卷入了一场古老的博弈。外星生物在公众视线之外的密林深处悄然潜行，被遗忘的往昔幽魂则向倾听者呢喃着甜言蜜语。肖恩究竟能稳住阵脚全身而退，还是会沦为棋盘上的又一枚棋子？

[摘自[url=https://waslock-the-sorcerer.itch.io/relics-of-the-serpent]itch.io[/url]]
